class.name: GoetheProject
class.brief_description: Read-only view of a Goethe narrative project manifest ([code].gproj.yaml[/code]).
class.description: [GoetheProject] loads character sheets, mood-specific portrait paths, scene registries, and global project variables authored in Goethe Dialogue Studio.

method.name: get_author
method.description: Returns the project author string.

method.name: get_character
method.description: Returns the character profile dictionary matching [param id_or_name], with portrait paths resolved relative to the manifest.

method.name: get_character_ids
method.description: Returns all character IDs defined in the cast.

method.name: get_default_locale
method.description: Returns the default BCP-47 locale configured for the project.

method.name: get_dialogues_dir
method.description: Returns the resolved dialogues directory path.

method.name: get_global_flags
method.description: Returns the registered project-wide boolean flag names.

method.name: get_global_vars
method.description: Returns the registered project-wide default variables.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last parse or file error message.

method.name: get_locales_dir
method.description: Returns the resolved locales directory path.

method.name: get_portrait_path
method.description: Resolves the portrait asset path for [param character_id] and optional [param mood], falling back to the character's default portrait.

method.name: get_portraits_dir
method.description: Returns the resolved portraits directory path.

method.name: get_project_name
method.description: Returns the human-readable project name.

method.name: get_scene
method.description: Returns the scene entry dictionary matching [param id_or_path].

method.name: get_scene_path
method.description: Returns the resolved dialogue YAML path for [param scene_id].

method.name: get_scenes
method.description: Returns all scene entries registered in the project manifest.

method.name: get_source_path
method.description: Returns the manifest path passed to [method load_from_file].

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns the project manifest version string.

method.name: has_character
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a character matching [param id_or_name] exists in the cast.

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a manifest is loaded.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Loads a [code].gproj.yaml[/code] manifest from [param path].

method.name: load_from_yaml
method.description: Loads a project manifest from an in-memory YAML string.
